newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish WIG index seen at 15,659 at mid-year-poll.
newsitem.headline: Polish WIG index seen at 15,659 at mid-year-poll.

text.p: Polish brokerages see the Warsaw bourse's main WIG index falling to 15,659 points at mid-year and rising to almost 17,000 at year-end, a monthly poll of financial daily Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki showed.
It showed the WIG was seen rising to 19,620 points by mid-1998.
Last month the brokerages saw the WIG index at 17,231 in the end of June and at 19,243 at the end of 1997.
The WIG index closed at 16,000.6 points on Friday.
